title: The Lost Colt
lines: Jill is a kind child with a wild colt.
In the cold, the colt slips past the gate.
Jill and Dad go to find it.
Dad holds a lamp up as they go.
Jill calls and calls, but no colt runs up.
Then Jill thinks. She gets the colt's dish.
She shakes it, and the colt jumps up.
It was behind an old gate all this time.
Jill held the dish and told it to hold still.
Most colts run off, but this colt did not.
The wild colt is home and is not cold.

questions.listenFor: Behind an old gate. Line eight says it — have them go back and find it themselves.

questions.ask: What did Jill do that made the colt come out?
questions.listenFor: She got the colt's dish and shook it. If they say "she called it," ask "did that work?"

questions.ask: The story calls the colt wild. What does wild mean here?
questions.listenFor: Not tame — it slips past the gate and will not come when called. Lines two, five and ten.
